You will hear a teacher telling a parent what five pupils enjoy doing at activity club.
Parent: Does Mia play the piano?
Teacher: No, Mia enjoys drawing cartoons.
Parent: What about Noah?
Teacher: He likes music. He plays the piano, but he does not sing.
Parent: Does Lily like dancing?
Teacher: She prefers taking photographs. She brings her camera each week.
Parent: And Omar?
Teacher: Omar enjoys solving puzzles with a friend.
Parent: What does Zoe do?
Teacher: She loves dancing. She can learn a new dance very quickly. They all have fun.
